gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the currently selected time tracking implementation for my Jira project so that I can ensure it aligns with our team's workflow.
gold.ideal: The API should return the currently selected time tracking implementation, including details such as the implementation name and any relevant configuration settings.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I need to update the time tracking implementation for our Jira instance to a new method that better suits our reporting needs.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the time tracking implementation and return a confirmation message along with the new configuration details.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to see a list of all available time tracking implementations so that I can evaluate which one would be best for our projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a comprehensive list of available time tracking implementations, including names, descriptions, and any prerequisites for each option.

gold.user: As a team lead, I want to access the shared time tracking configuration to ensure that all team members are using the same settings for consistency in reporting.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current shared time tracking configuration, detailing settings such as time tracking formats and any shared rules applied across projects.

gold.user: As a configuration manager, I need to set the shared time tracking configuration for our organization to standardize how time is tracked across all projects.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the shared time tracking configuration and return a confirmation along with the updated settings to verify the changes.
